title: Four rabbis attempt celestial ascent

tellings.quote: This is reflected in the Jewish parable of the parties, where four rabbis attempted celestial ascent and only one came back alive with his sanity intact.

plain: In an old Jewish tale known as the Pardes, or the orchard, four rabbis tried to rise up into the heavens, and only one came back alive with his mind intact. Michels tells it himself as a parable, in an episode with an MIT scientist about reality as a hologram. He uses it to show that ancient traditions warned how dangerous contact with higher realms could be.
